examples.english: After the disaster, it took a long time to return to normal life.

notes:
Refers to the state of things being normal, especially as contrasted with exceptional or emergency situations. Composed of {平|へい} (flat, calm) and {常|じょう} (always, ordinary). The compound ⟦{平常心|へいじょうしん}→平常心：21200_heijoushin⟧ (equanimity, calm composure) is particularly common in martial arts and sports.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {平常|へいじょう}{心|しん}: composure, equanimity
- {平常|へいじょう}{通|どお}り: as usual, as normal
- {平常|へいじょう}⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧: normal times (as opposed to emergencies)
- {平常|へいじょう}⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧: normal operation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧: normal, ordinary — the most common everyday word
- ⟦{通常|つうじょう}→通常：27316_tsuujou⟧: usual, ordinary — slightly more formal, common in writing
- ⟦{日常|にちじょう}→日常：01595_nichijou⟧: daily life, everyday — emphasizes routine
